Class Database

java.lang.Object
database.Database
public class Database extends Object

Title: Database Class.

Description: This is an in-memory database built on H2. Detailed documentation of H2 can be found at https://www.h2database.com/html/main.html (Click on "PDF (2MB)" on the l3ft side of the page under the heading "Reference" for a PDF of 438 pages.) This class leverages H2 and provides numerous special supporting methods.

    • Database

    • Database

      public Database(String dbUrl)

      Method: Database(String dbUrl)

      Description: This constructor allows the caller to specify an alternate JDBC URL. It is used by the automated testing classes to run against a private in-memory H2 database (e.g., "jdbc:h2:mem:test;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1") so the tests never alter the production database.

      Parameters:
      dbUrl - is the JDBC URL of the H2 database to be used by this instance

    • generateInvitationCode

      public String generateInvitationCode(String emailAddress, String role)

      Method: String generateInvitationCode(String emailAddress, String role)

      Description: Given an email address and a roles, this method establishes and invitation code and adds a record to the InvitationCodes table. When the invitation code is used, the stored email address is used to establish the new user and the record is removed from the table.

      Parameters:
      emailAddress - specifies the email address for this new user.
      role - specified the role that this new user will play.
      Returns:
      the code of six characters so the new user can use it to securely setup an account.

    • generateInvitationCode

      public String generateInvitationCode(String emailAddress, String role, LocalDateTime deadline)

      Method: String generateInvitationCode(String emailAddress, String role, LocalDateTime deadline)

      Description: Given an email address, a role, and a deadline, this method establishes an invitation code that is only valid until the deadline. Once the deadline has passed, the code can no longer be used to set up an account and the invitation will be purged.

      Parameters:
      emailAddress - specifies the email address for this new user.
      role - specified the role that this new user will play.
      deadline - specifies the date and time after which the invitation is no longer valid.
      Returns:
      the code of six characters so the new user can use it to securely setup an account, or an empty string if the deadline is null or not in the future.

    • updateUserRole

      public boolean updateUserRole(String username, String role, String value)

      Method: boolean updateUserRole(String username, String role, String value)

      Description: Update a specified role for a specified user's and set and update all the current user attributes. The request is rejected (false is returned) when the value is not "true" or "false", when the role is not one of "Admin", "Contributor", "Viewer", or "Curator", or when the request would remove the Admin role from the only remaining Admin.

      Parameters:
      username - is the username of the user
      role - is string that specifies the role to update ("Admin", "Contributor", "Viewer", or "Curator")
      value - is the string "true" or "false" for the role
      Returns:
      true if the update was successful, else false

    • deleteUser

      public boolean deleteUser(String username)

      Method: boolean deleteUser(String username)

      Description: Remove a user from the database. The request is refused (false is returned) when the user does not exist or when the user is the only remaining Admin, since the system must always keep at least one Admin. An authenticated Admin session is also required. The caller (the GUI) is responsible for asking the Admin "Are you sure?" before invoking this method.

      Parameters:
      username - is the username of the user to be deleted
      Returns:
      true if the user was deleted, else false

    • setOneTimePassword

      public boolean setOneTimePassword(String username, String oneTimePassword, LocalDateTime deadline)

      Method: boolean setOneTimePassword(String username, String oneTimePassword, LocalDateTime deadline)

      Description: Store a one-time password for a user together with the deadline after which it can no longer be used. The request is refused when the user does not exist, the password is empty, or the deadline is missing or not in the future. Setting a new one-time password replaces any earlier one.

      Parameters:
      username - is the username of the user
      oneTimePassword - is the temporary password the Admin will give the user
      deadline - is the date and time after which the one-time password is no longer valid
      Returns:
      true if the one-time password was stored, else false

    • loginWithOneTimePassword

      public boolean loginWithOneTimePassword(String username, String oneTimePassword)

      Method: boolean loginWithOneTimePassword(String username, String oneTimePassword)

      Description: Check whether the supplied text matches the user's stored one-time password and that the deadline has not passed. A successful match atomically clears the password and deadline in the same database statement, so even simultaneous requests cannot redeem it twice. An expired one-time password is removed as a side effect.

      Parameters:
      username - is the username of the user
      oneTimePassword - is the text the user typed into the password field
      Returns:
      true if the one-time password matched, was still valid, and was consumed; else false

    • deleteUserAccount

      public Database.DeletionResult deleteUserAccount(int targetId, boolean confirmed) throws SQLException
      Removes an account only after explicit Yes. No/cancel performs no database work. This implementation uses hard deletion, matching the supplied schema (no active flag). All admin rows are locked in ID order before checking authorization and the target. Therefore two administrators cannot concurrently delete one another and leave no admin. The operation commits only its own transaction; failures roll back and propagate.
      Parameters:
      targetId - database identity captured when the account was selected
      confirmed - true only when the confirmation dialog returned Yes
      Returns:
      the precise outcome for display and automated testing
      Throws:
      SQLException - if persistence fails; no success should be displayed
